title: Materialize the Hungarian-first FA3 marketing current-host runtime stack
decision: Deploy Mautic, Twenty and listmonk as replaceable provider runtimes on rootless Podman with persistent local state, loopback-only operator endpoints, externalized secrets, explicit release tags followed by immutable current-host image locking, and a network-internal SMTP sink for production-path E2E without external mail delivery.
rationale: Mautic 7.2.0 source release is newer, but the current official Docker Hub release image verified for admission is 7.1.3-apache.
Twenty uses an explicit patch tag; floating latest/v2 tags are not admitted.
listmonk v6.2.0 is the current stable release candidate and avoids the in-progress v7 line.
Real provider APIs and durable databases are exercised; reference CI cannot promote runtime state.
